page.layout: One column of running text. Three marginal references in the right margin, each beside its text mark. No text in the left margin. Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.l: est Debitum. Debitum Officii, quod quis
Debitum Supplicii, quod quis ex sancti-
one juris tenetur pati, si officium suum
charitatis officia esse debita, quia lex
Dei illa præcipit, juxta illud Rom.13.
cata esse debita, ut in oratione Domi-
contrahi ex infoluto priori : ita ut si quis
faciendo id quod lex imperat, non tene-
tur aliquo debito supplicii ad patien-
dum id quod lex minatur. Respondet
duplici huic Debito duplex item Obli-
gatio ad Pœnam. Ita tamen ut illa sit
prior & potior, sicut natura sua, sic &
non juris, pœnam intendere aliter quam

page.notes: Printed page is the left half of a two-page opening? No: one page, numbered 21. Left edge is cropped, so the first letters of "est", "contrahi" and "recidit" are partly lost; "est" is read from the context "eft", "contrahi" and "recidit" are reconstructed with [?] reading absent. Printed "debete" (for debere) and "Pec-cata" are kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout (fenfu = sensu, fi = si, fuum = suum, fanctione = sanctione, fupplicii = supplicii, fit = sit, eft = est, fic = sic, fua = sua, ejufdem = ejusdem). Running head "Prælectio Prima." reads as printed; the ligature "ct" is uncertain. "diffolveret" is kept as printed. Text continues on the next page ("in" is the catchword).
